rows: Conducting elections to Panchayats and Municipalities
Exclusive legal remedy required to challenge and potentially cancel an election result

items: Article 243K specifically governs elections to Panchayats and Municipalities by the State Election Commission, not the Election Commission of India.
Delimitation of constituencies is carried out by the Delimitation Commission.
An election result cannot be directly voided by the Commission without an election petition.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Elections to local bodies (Panchayats and Municipalities) are conducted by the State Election Commission as mandated by Article 243K.
The delimitation of electoral constituencies is performed by the dedicated Delimitation Commission.
The Election Commission lacks the power to unilaterally cancel an election result unless it is challenged through a formal election petition.
